scope: Standalone source-only viewport probe and its launch/tests/documentation. Production scene routing/settings, engine pin and gameplay/network/persistent contracts are unchanged.

ownership.settings: fixtures/rendering/viewport.json owns all declared display values. viewport_settings.gd validates/narrows fixture input and owns content-rectangle calculation.
ownership.world: viewport_world.gd owns test-only camera, numbered terrain, immutable fixture anchors and markers.
ownership.scene: viewport_probe.gd owns its native UI/pointer, native resize/capture operations and the sequential behavioral checks for this single test scene. Length reviewed: separate named test phases keep layout and assertions traceable; no general graphics framework or production manager introduced.
ownership.evidence: Existing launcher/canonical extractor validate WorldPoint, FixtureRunEvidence, TestCheck, ValidationFinding and their closure; no parallel domain contract or renderer schema added.

network_security: N/A: no gameplay authority, transport, RPC, server spawning or persistence is added.
comments_types_resources: New scripts are typed, use descriptive names and retained generated UIDs. No new code comments, reflection, unsafe casts, warning suppression or dependency changes.
limitations: Only current Retina 2x macOS/Metal was exercised; other physical displays remain unverified.
No human art approval or camera-motion/export certification.
snapshot_integration: Only source_registry_sha256 changed in the existing content snapshot after planning metadata review. Definition closure/hash and all graphical source/capture hashes are unchanged; final-source-run executes the final clean game commit.
